I: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cum venit igitur plenitudo temporis \u8230 \'85-\u8230 \'85 que caritati tangenda sunt ut vitiorum fere occidantur. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (251\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -347\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Liber IV: Einleitungssatz: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 His tractatis que ad doctrinam rerum pertinent\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85\~; (251\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -253\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Capitulatio; Text: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Samaritanus enim uulnerato appropians curationi eius sacramentorum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 alligamenta adhibuit \u8230 \'85-\u8230 \'85 Hec de pedibus sedentis super solium\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (dar\u252 \'fcber geschrieben: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ysaia VII\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 [6, 1]) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 excelsum quas seraphin \u8230 \'85-\u8230 \'85 per media ad pedes usque via duce\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 peruenit.- Explicit feliciter\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (s. o.) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 anno domini 1476\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .- 348\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rv\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Druck\~: \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Petrus Lombardus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Sententiae in IV libros distinctae. T. 1.2. Ed. 3. Grottaferrata 1971-1981. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \endash 119\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6922/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f2\b\fs24\chcbpat18 Psalterium feriatum}} \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 Die Grundform des \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Psalterium\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 umfasst die biblischen Psalmen fortlaufend in ihrer Reihenfolge 1-150 (1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -97\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ). Sie sind entsprechend der nicht-monastischen Einteilung (k\u246 \'f6nnte auch ein Hinweis auf die Herkunft aus einem Kollegiatstift sein) gegliedert in Ps 1-108 f\u252 \'fcr die Matutin, Ps 109-147 f\u252 \'fcr die Vesper und Ps 148-150 f\u252 \'fcr die Laudes. Diese wiederum sind unterteilt nach den Ferialtagen, jeweils eingeleitet durch eine gro\u223 \'dfe Deckfarbeninitiale: (1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Dominica: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Beatus vir\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Ps 1); (14\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Fer. IV: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dixit insipiens\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Ps 52); (40\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Fer. VI: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Exultate\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Ps 80); (63\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Sabb.: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cantate domino\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Ps 97). \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (74\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -97\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Auf die Matutinalpsalmen folgen die f\u252 \'fcr Vesper und Laudes, beginnend mit Dominica ad laudes: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dixit dominus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Ps 109). \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (97\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -105\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Es schlie\u223 \'dfen sich an die \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Cantica\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Canticum Ysaie< Confitebor tibi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; Canticum Ezechiae, Annae, Moysi (\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cantabo domino\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ), Habacuc, Moysi (\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Audite caeli\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ); (103\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ymnus trium puerorum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 <; >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Canticum sancte Marie\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 < (\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Magnificat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ); \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Canticum Simeonis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ; (105\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Hymnus >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ambrosii< Te deum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (105\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Symbolum Athanasii: >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Fides Athanasii episcopi< Quicumque uult salus esse\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \endash ... \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 saluus esse non potest. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (107\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -109\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Litaniae\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 sanctorum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (zweispaltig): >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Letanya< Kyrieleyson\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Die Litanei wurde im 15. Jh. teilweise gel\u246 \'f6scht und ab: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Omnes sancti apostoli et ewangeliste\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 durch andere Heiligennamen ersetzt, die f\u252 \'fcr die Zisterzienser charakteristisch sind: S. Nach einer kurzen Unterbrechung auf 108\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 l\u228 \'e4uft der Text in der urspr\u252 \'fcnglichen Fassung weiter mit: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ab appetitu inanis libera nos. Ab omni\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 immunditia mentis et corporis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Die Litanei schlie\u223 \'dft wie \u252 \'fcblich mit F\u252 \'fcrbitten und Orationen. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (109\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -116\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Officium parvum BMV\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Incipit cursus sancte Marie virginis< Domine labia\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 mea aperies\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Im Binnenraum der Initiale \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 D\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Muttergottes mit Kind. Vollst\u228 \'e4ndiges Offizium. Im Anschluss an die Vesper Suffragien der Heiligen Nicolaus, Katherina und aller Heiligen. Das Offzium endet mit der Complet. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (116\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -119\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Vesper\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ae \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 defunctorum \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Das Psalterium wurde nach dem \u220 \'dcbergang in den Besitz des Zisterzienserinnenklosters Weida, 1453 (s. o.) durch Zus\u228 \'e4tze an den Blattr\u228 \'e4ndern in ein Psalterium feriatum umgestaltet. So wurde jeweils am Beginn einer Feria die Antiphon zur Matutin notiert, z. B. zur Dominica (3\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ): >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ant< Seruite domino in timore et exultate ei cum tremore\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , zur Feria II (14\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ): >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ant<\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dominus de celo prospexit super filios hominum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . Etc. Auch wurden die Antiphonen zu den Laudes des jeweiligen Tages am Rande vermerkt. Eine andere fl\u252 \'fcchtige Hand notierte, ohne ersichtliche Ordnung \u252 \'fcber das Psalterium verstreut, einzelne Bibelverse gleichsam wie Anregungen zur Meditation.}

Anlass gelegentlich von sp\u228 \'e4terer Hand am Seitenrand notiert (78\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f2\fs24 Philippi et Jacobi; 79\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f2\fs24 In die pentecostes; 87\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f2\fs24 Parasceve; 93\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f2\fs24 Sabbato sancto). \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[0].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Non turbetur cor uestrum (Io 14,1) pro morte mee carnis}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quia deus sum\plain \f2\fs24 \u8230 \'85 >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Glossa< Non\plain \f2\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 turbetur cor: Ne autem mortem tamquam homines timerent\plain \f2\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (14,2) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In domo patris mei mansiones multe sunt i. e. diversa premia meritorum. >Glossa< In domo p. m. domus dei, templum\plain \f2\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 dei regnum\plain \f2\fs24 \u8230 \'85 etc. (14,14) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Si quid petieritis in nomine meo hoc faciam\plain \f2\fs24 . (79\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f2\fs24 ) Nachgetragene \u220 \'dcberschrift (Seitentitel): >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In die pentecostes\plain \f2\fs24 <.-[S]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 i diligitis me, ut faciatis que ego\plain \f2\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ut faciam que petitis, mandata mea seruate\plain \f2\fs24 (14,15) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 in quo euidenter ostenditur dilectio mandantis\plain \f2\fs24 . >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Glossa< Quomodo monet diligere et seruare mandata ut accipient spiritum\plain \f2\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Etc. Es folgen (79v) die Auslegung von Io 14,23; (80\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f2\fs24 ) 15,1; (81\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f2\fs24 ) 15,12; (81\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f2\fs24 ) 15,17; (82\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f2\fs24 ) 15,26 und 16,5; (83\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f2\fs24 ) 16,16; (84\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f2\fs24 ) 16,20; (85\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f2\fs24 ) 16,33; (87\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f2\fs24 ) 18,1. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (93\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f2\fs24 ) Seitentitel: >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In sabbato sancto pasce\plain \f2\fs24 < 20,1; (93\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f2\fs24 ) 20,11; (94\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f2\fs24 ) 5,17: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Pater meus usque modo operatur i. e. quasi ceci estis in lege, cur mihi inuidistis ... >Glossa< Quia commoti sunt de audita eius equalitate \u8230 \'85-\u8230 \'85 qui uero mala egerunt in resurrectionem iudicii i. e. dampnacionis\plain \f2\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (95\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f2\fs24 ) Io 5,30: [N]on \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 possum ego a meipso facere quicquam dedit potestatem iudicii \u8230 \'85 >Glossa< Ego filius hominis nichil a me possum \u8230 \'85-\u8230 \'85 Si autem illius litteris non creditis que de me testantur quomodo uerbis meis credetis qui a lege predictus sum. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f2\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Druck: PL 114, 355 B-426 B. \endash \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Glorieux\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Pour revaloriser Migne, S. 57. \endash CC CM 152, Einleitung. \uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -87\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 Evangelium secundum Johannem cum glossa ordinaria\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 Prologus: [Hic est] {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[0].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Johannes euangelista unus ex discipulis dei}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 et deo magisterii doctrina\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 seruetur.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , RB 624. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 Glossa marginalis beginnt bereits vor dem Evangelientext (1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ): {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[1].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Omnibus diuine scripture paginis}}\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 euangelium excellit \u8230 \'85 matrem virginem commendant\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , RB 11830 \plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 5-8\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash (2\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rc\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sum, uerbum et dupplicem habet significationem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Ste\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 g\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 m\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , RB 11830\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 10\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (2\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Beginn des Evangeliums: [I]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 n principio erat uerbum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85; (2\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Glossa marginalis: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Johannes\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 interpretatur gratia dei \u8230 \'85 humanis mentibus intimare\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , RB 11830\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 3\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sum uerbum. duplicem habet significationem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (s. o. 2\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rc\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ). [A]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 lii patre qui est principium sine\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 principio filius de principio licet principium \u8230 \'85 omnia habent principium existendi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , RB 11830\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 9\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ; die Glossa marginalis wird als Glossa interlinearis fortgesetzt: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Non in\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Maria incepit ut quidam uolebant. Ut idem in substantia etsi alius in persona\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Etc. Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , RB 11830\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 19\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 Die Glosse entspricht auf weiten Strecken der des Walahfridus Strabo, PL 114, 355 B-426 B (= Explicit), enth\u228 \'e4lt aber auch zahlreiche Abweichungen. Die Glosse zu Vers 25: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Non dicit posse capi spatio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85geht dieser voraus. Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , RB 11830\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 19\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .}

Sciendum uero quia deus pater preuidens preuidens tribulationes \u8230 \'85 passionem designatam intellectu suo configurauit etc.- Causas uero que beatum Johannem uolue et uidebis dictam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 causam vbi inuenis hoc signum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 [Zeichen hier angef\u252 \'fchrt]. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Druck\~: De \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Bruyne\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Pr\u233 \'e9faces, S. 263 f. Nr. 9g + 8 f. \endash \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Ste\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 g\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 m\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , RB 832. 11853\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 2\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -49\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezper[0].4100/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Anselmus Laudunensis (?)}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 : {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[1].6930gi/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Enarrationes in Apocalypsin}} \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Incipit liber apocalipsis Johannis apostoli< Apocalipsis Jhesu Christi quam dedit illi deus palam facere seruis suis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (Apc 1,1). Prologus: {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[2].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Causa que beatum Johannem scribere monuit}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 : quia interim dum ipse exul teneretur a Domiciano \u8230 \'85 non diffidentes de remuneratione.-\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -49\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Textus cum glossa: >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Accessus ad litteram< {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[0].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Ac si ita commoneret attendite hanc uisionem}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quia hec uisio reuelata Jhesu Christo secundum quod homo \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (?). Damit beginnen Marginal- wie auch Interlinearglosse. Fortsetzung der Glossa marginalis: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Que oportet fieri cito scil. tribulationes uenturas et cito transituras et premia subsecutura habet \u8230 \'85 Bene dixit cito, quia omne tempus huius uite comparatum eternitati momentaneum est \u8230 \'85 Johannes est\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 figura totius ecclesie\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Etc. \endash Glossa interlinearis: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dedit illi deus, scil. pater palam facere\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Seruis suis: humilibus suis non Judeis superbis uel philosophis. Que oportet fieri eam scil. ut tribulationes in ecclesia et remunerationes. Cito: et ne aliquis diceret: quis poterit tamdiu pati\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ideo dicit: cito\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Etc.\u8230 \'85 Interlinear und Marginalglosse nicht immer scharf von einander abgegrenzt. Zwischen 31\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 und 32\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 leere Seite; ausgelassen: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Mitte falcem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 tuam acutam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Apc 14,18b) mit Glosse. Fortsetzuing 32\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 mit: ||\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et uindemiam botros uinee\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 terre\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 und Glosse: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 separa maturos in nequitia\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Etc. Endet (49\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) mit Apc 22,21: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dicit qui testimonium perhibet istorum etiam uenio cito. Amen. Veni domine Jhesu. Gratia domini\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 nostri Jhesu Christi cum omnibus uobis. Amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash Glosse endet: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dicit: Quasi dicat: ego excommunico et Jhesus confirmat. Amen: Idest uera sunt omnia que dicta sunt et ideo si quis mutauerit excommunicetur. Veni: Dicit apostolus domino ex nimia affectione desiderantis ut ueniat ad remunerandum. Gratia: uerba apostoli et confirmat Christum cito uenturum. \endash >Explicit liber apocalipsis Johannis apostoli<.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Der Grund f\u252 \'fcr die ausf\u252 \'fchrlichen Textzitate liegt darin, dass die Marginalglosse gedruckt nicht nachgewiesen werden konnte, w\u228 \'e4hrend die in Migne abgedruckte Interlinearglosse des Anselmus Laudunensis offenbar einer anderen Text\u252 \'fcberlieferung folgt. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Druck: PL 162, 1500 D \endash 1586 D (mit Textabweichungen, s. o.). \endash Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , RB 1361. 11853\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 7\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 (Prolog). \endash Zur schwierigen Frage nach der Autorschaft vgl. Nihilominus est dicendum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Secundo cur in psalmorum titulis quasi auctorum, nomina diuersa repperiuntur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 [Sextodecimo:] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De eleoquentia propria psalterii\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . [Septimodecimo:] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Laus ecclesie. Nunc ad\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 missum ordinem domino prestante ueniamus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Die Kapitelzahlen sind links und rechts vom Text in roten r\u246 \'f6mischen Zahlen angegeben. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (4\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -14r) >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De prophetia< {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[0].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Prophetia est aspiratio diuina}}\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Etc. Die Praefaio endet (14\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ): \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nunc minutatim ad exponenda psalterii uerba ueniamus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (14\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Expositio psalmorum: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Incipit eiusdem expositio digesta psalmorum quare primus psalmus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 non habet titulum< {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[1].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Psalmus hic ideo non habet titulum}}\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (bricht 14\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ab:) \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 secunda uero peccatorum nequities in futuro iudicio //. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Druck: CCser. lat. In finem psalmus letitie resurrectionis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (77\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 omnis qui speratis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 in domino\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Ps 30,23).\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Hier bricht die Enarratio ab. 77\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -78\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 leer. XXI. a. Primo igitur considerandum}}\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quid est quod Jhesus appropinquasset Jero\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 [solimis] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 venit Bethphage et ad Bethaniam per montem Oliueti. Vnusquisque potest elongare se a Jesu per peccatum \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 salua super\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 dona gratie addendo gloriam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Schneyer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Repertorium Bd. 4, S. 818 Nr. 1.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (5\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 appropinquasset Jhesus Jerosolimis etc.vsque ibi: Benedictus qui venit in nomine domini. Mt XXI a. Ewangelium istud legitur in Ramis palmarum \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 sed quasi proiectum conculcant.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Schneyer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 a. a. O. Nr. 2. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 Es folgen die Sermones Nr. 3-25. (79\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) 27-31. 34. 36. 37. 38 (= Nr. 1). 39. 40 + 41. 42. 43. 46. 51-53. 55. Hier endet der 1. Teil (173\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ): \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Explicit prima pars omeliarum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 173\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (174\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -347\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Pars II: >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In dominica post trinitatem< {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[1].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Homo quidam erat diues \u8230 \'85 etc. Luc XVI (19). Notandum quare dixit}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 : Homo quidam \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 memor esto iudicii mei, si enim erit etc\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 meum erit tuum hodie\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Schneyer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Repertorium Bd. 4, S. 822 Nr. 56. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 Die folgenden Sermones stimmen mit der bei Schneyer zu Grunde liegenden \u220 \'dcberlieferung teilweise nicht \u252 \'fcberein. Manche Sermones sind zu einer zusammengefasst, andere in mehrere aufgeteilt, so dass bisweilen nur Incipit oder Explicit identisch sind. Es folgen (184\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 )\~die Sermones Nr. 57. (190\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) 58: {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[2].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Homo quidam fecit cenam magnam etc. (Lc 14, 17). Primo uidendum est quare dixit}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 : homo quidam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 (abweichend von Schneyer mehrere Sermones unter demselben Lemma) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quia ergo non lambunt sanguinem i. e. non intrantur Christi passionem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 non sunt pulli aquile eiciendi a ludo eius ut reprobi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (191\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quia vero ante sompnum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 mortis sue hanc cenam fecit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 vt refecti hoc cibo fortiores essent tempore passionis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (192\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sequitur magnam: Magna enim fuit hec cena refectione magna \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 hic est panis de\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 celo descendens vt si quis manducaueritis ex ipso non moriatur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (195\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Hoc autem cum tripliciter comedebatur \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Si extra disciplinam estis etc. non estis filii sed adulteri.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (196\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sequitur: Et hora cene misit seruum suum dicere inuitatis vt venirent \u8230 \'85 Nunc est hora cene,\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 in futuro non erit \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85stimulatus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (\~?) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 est quo iter ad dominum acceleratur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (wie Schneyer, Nr. 60). 59, mit dem Schluss von Nr. 58: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In cuius cognitione et uerbi incarnati tota cena consistit quam nobis concedere dignetur Christus. Amen. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Es folgt Nr. 61 mit dem Schluss: \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et incuruatus sum etc. et ibi tota die conquirens\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (?) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ingrediebar\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (202\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sequitur: Nonne dimittit etc. in deserto et uadit ad illam que perierat \u8230 \'85 Nota\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 V hic dicuntur \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 gemitum auscultant amici i. e. angeli quia in eo delectantur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (204\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quis inquit est homo qui habet C oues etc.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Lc 15,4). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quid ergo est ouis centesima nisi uirginitas\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 unde et tu aliquando conuersus etc\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (205\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sequitur: Aut que mulier habens dragmas etc. Dragma perfecte actionis forma. Dragma enim X continet denarios \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 per\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 eorum luxurias consumuntur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (207\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sequitur: Et cum consumpsisset omnia facta est fames\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Lc 15,14) \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In hoc ostenditur effectus peccati \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 aser pinguis panis eius etc\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (208\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sequitur: Surgam et ibo ad patrem meum etc. Surgit qui a terrenis desiderii se leuat \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 uel in me autem salus tua\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Schneyer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Nr. 61. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (212\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Estote misericordes\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Nr. 66. 68. 69. 70-73. 76. Cui apostolo qui resistat imperio dei qui saluat \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 quidam promittentes\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (I Tim 6,21). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Qui fidem quasi imperitiam rident. Circa fidem. semper circa numquam intra. Exciderunt. A. fide. Gratia tecum. Ut hec custodias. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , RB 11842 (nur auszugseise identisch). \par \pard\sl360\slmult1\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (119\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -124\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 Epistola ad Timotheum II \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 In prologum: {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[13].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Paulus iam a mundo transiturus}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 item scribit a Roma Timotheo \u8230 \'85 multis modis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Glossa marginalis: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Capitulum primum< Paulus apostolus Christi Jhesu\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (II Tim 1,1). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Gratias ago quoniam habeam memoriam tui \u8230 \'85 hec est sapiens exortatio ad ulteriora \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Saluta\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (II Tim 4,19). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Precepit auctoritatem ab episcopo non esse descendam propter humilitatem. Sola enim humilitas sine imperio \u8230 \'85 quam auctoritatem iste penitus prtermiserat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Glossa interlinearis: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Paulus apostolus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (II Tim 1,1). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cuius officii tu es particeps. secundum promissionem. Pro hac promissione legitime certo hoc meis sequacibus promitto \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Gratia uobiscum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (II Tim 4, 22). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ne admonitus irascaris i. e. maneat uestra dilectio. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , RB 11842 (nur auszugsweise identisch). \par \pard\sl360\slmult1\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (124\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -127\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 Epistola ad Titum \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 In prologum: {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[26].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Tito relicto Crete episcopo}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ex simplicitate et humilitate \u8230 \'85 a Nicopoli\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Glossa marginalis: {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[21].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Quidam sunt qui credi non possunt}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 nisi prius intelligantur ut filium die mori nisi prius agnitam historiam de incarnatione \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Cum misero ad te Artemam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Tit 3,12). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Hactenus de imperio et auctoritate habenda. Incipit de domesticis ne quis seductione eum capiat in itinere. Hoc precepit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Glossa interlinearis: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Paulus seruus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Tit 1,1\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ). Hic ostendit humilitatem cum autoritate quasi dicens: humilitas non tollit potestatem \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Saluta eos qui nos amant in fide. Non ficte. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , RB 11843 (nur auszugsweise identisch). \par \pard\sl360\slmult1\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (127\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -128\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 Epistola ad Philemon \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 In prologum: {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[17].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Philemoni familiares litteras mittit}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 pro Onesimo seruo eius \u8230 \'85 scriberis a Roma de carcere\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Glossa Marginalis: {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[15].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Paulus uinctus (Phlm 1). Non dicit apostolus nomen}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 dignitatis sed humilitatis \u8230 \'85cruciaueris \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Ita frater ego te fruar\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Phlm 20). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Minus exibo quam debes\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Glossa interlinearis: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Paulus uinctus Jhesu Christi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Phlm 1). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cuius etiam causa debes misereri \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Simul autem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Phlm 22). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Uel hic mouet ad ueniam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , RB 11844 (nur auszugsweise identisch). \par \pard\sl360\slmult1\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (128\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -150\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 Epistola ad Hebraeos \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 Argumentum: {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[1].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Cum aliqui in (?) Hebreorum ecclesia}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 preter\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (?) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 paucos eminentiores fidem Christi absque legalibus insufficientem ad salutem crederent \u8230 \'85 rebus in predicta caritate consumptis auidius restaurare curabant\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 In prologum: {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[2].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Ecclesiis Hebreorum scribit Paulus}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 de eminentia Christi et inutilitate legis \u8230 \'85 et maior est eis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . Nota a Roma scripsisse\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Glossa Interlinearis: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Multiphariam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Hebr 1,1). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 multis locutionibus. Multisque modis. multis qualitatibus \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Omnes sanctos\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Hebr 13,24). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 subiectos. in baptismate.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Hic Pauli finis qui nos sustulit ab imis. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , RB 11845 (nur auszugsweise identisch). \par \pard\sl360\slmult1\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (150\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -150\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 Commentarius in epistolam ad Hebraeos \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[5].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 [I]ntendit ergo apostolus in hac epistola}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 persuadere solam fidem Jhesu Christi puram et simplicem esse \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 cum narrat scripturam dominum patrem introduxisse et intimasse\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 // (Bricht ab mit Seitenende). \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , RB 10484 (anonym \u252 \'fcberliefert in Paris, BN {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5007[0]/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\chcbpat18 lat. 13209}}\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , 12. Textzeile sp\u228 \'e4ter in Geheimschrift dar\u252 \'fcber geschrieben: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 xfrsxs Jphbnnks dkaconk \u8230 \'85 sxsxkpf pbstpr ufnfrbndf trkxmphps\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (1\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -3\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Prologus: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Incipit prefatio Johannis Diaconi aecclesiae Romane De uita beati Gregorii pape< Beatissimo ac felicissimo domino Johanni sanctae catholicae et apostolicae romanae ecclesiae presuli Johannes ultimus leuitarum. {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[1].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Nuper ad uigilias beati Gregorii}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 romani pontificis \u8230 \'85 et in futuro a peccatorum nexibus merear misericorditer liberari. Explicit prologus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (3\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Incipiunt capitula libri primi< I. \uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 5. 50\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -74\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 Reimgebete und Leselieder zu Maria \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Oratio valde bona de beata Maria< {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[1].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Domina mea sancta Maria perpetua uirgo}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 uirginum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85-\u8230 \'85 (52\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 salubrem prosperitatem in hoc seculo concede per Christum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . Es folgen: (52\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sancta Maria mater domini nostri Jhesu Christi in manus benedicti filii tui commendo me hodie \u8230 \'85;\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (53\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Gaude virgo mater Christi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 AH 15 Nr. 68, Str. 1. 2. 4. 5. 6. Anschlie\u223 \'dfend Gebetsintentionen: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In omni tribulatione et angustia nostra etc. oremus: Deus qui beatissimam virginem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 matrem Mariam \u8230 \'85 duplici gaudio letificasti\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Etc. (53\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 )\~ \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ave principium\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Chev. 2059. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Abla\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ss\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Papa Innocentius concessit cuilibet dicenti istam orationem beate\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Marie virginis cotidie centum dies in dulgencie et sciat certissime uidere beatam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Mariam\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85\~; (54\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Oratio: {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[3].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Obsecro te domina sancta Maria mater}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 dei \u8230 \'85-\u8230 \'85 audi et exaudi dulcissima Maria\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 mater dei et misericordie. Aue Maria gracia plena\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .- (55\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Abla\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ss\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Papa Bonifacius constituit ut quicumque \u8230 \'85 {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[2].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Ista oratio debet dici in sacramento altaris}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 in uisione corporis et sanguinis Christi \u8230 \'85>Oratio< Ave Maria gratia plena \u8230 \'85 martir cum martiribus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 transgladiata morte sacratissima filii tui rogo te\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85\~; (56\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Reimgebet\~: {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[0].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Ave mundi spes Maria}}\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 AH 15 Nr. 123. - (56\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Eya rosa sine spina\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Chev. 26039. - (57\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) AH 32 Nr. 12\~; (58\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) AH 46 Nr. 172. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (59\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -60\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Marienlitanei\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Kyrieleyson, Christeleyson. Christe audi nos. Sancta dei genitrix intercede pro me. Sancta virgo virginum intercede pro me \u8230 \'85 nec dimittas me sine adiutorio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 tuo. Amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .- (60\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -62\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Ablassgebet\~: >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Si quis hanc oracionem nonaginta diebus dixerit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quodcumque uelit sone dubio a domino impetrabit. Magnificat ter Aue Maria< {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[4].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Rogo te beata virgo Maria}}\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Alle folgenden Anrufungen beginnen: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Rogo te beata Maria\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (62\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -63\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Abla\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ss\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quicumque hanc oracionem de beata virgine deuote dixerit VII annos indulgencie \u8230 \'85 Confirmatum est a beato papa Bonifacio< {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[6].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Stabat mater dolorosa}}\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 iuxta crucem lacrimosa\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 AH 54 Nr. 201 [De compassione BMV]. Mit anschlie\u223 \'dfendem Gebet >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In omni tribulatione< Interueniat pro nobis domine Jhesu Christe nunc et in hora mortis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 nostre \u8230 \'85 virgo Maria\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Vgl. A. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Krass\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Stabat mater dolorosa. M\u252 \'fcnchen 1998, S. 30. 44. 46. 51. 147 A. 3. 151 f. 154 (zitiert diese Hs. unter Sigle M2). \par \pard\sl360\slmult1\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (63\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -70\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Mariengebet\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 mit vielen Lesestrophen, die alle mit dem Ruf: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 O Maria\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 enden. \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Oracio bona< {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[5].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Salue regina mater misericordie, mater spes et mater venie}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 , mater in qua totius glorie\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 o Maria \u8230 \'85-\u8230 \'85 Ad quam qui ad te confugiunt omnes sint redempti, o Maria. Amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . - (70\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Schreibervermerk\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Istam orationem beate virginis gloriose scripsit frater Petrus \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 [ ] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 de Argentina ordinis beate Marie de monte Carmeli prouincie Almanie inferioris filius conuentus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Argentinensis quodam studens Tholose. Orate pro eo pater noster et Aue Maria\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 .- Anschlie\u223 \'dfend: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 O virgo dulcissima optentu fideli/ precamur defende nos morte tam crudeli\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 /\u8230 \'85 2. Strophe: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Tu\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 gloria Libani decor Carmeli \u8230 \'85 Et ad montem glorie tecum, tolleremur. Amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . - (70\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ave ancilla trinitatis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Chev 1692; (73\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ave virgo nobilis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 AH 3 Nr. 3. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (74\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Ehrentitel Mariens\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In uersuum capitibus reperitur titulus videlicet annulus beate virginis Marie< Quicumque infra scripta septuaginta duo nomina beate Marie virginis ante ymaginem suam deuote dixerit sine dubio beata virgo Maria defendet eum ab omni malo corporis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et anime: Virgo viua, flos, nubes, Regina theothocos\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Etc. Am Ende dieses Textes (74\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) steht der Schreibername: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Frater Thomas\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (75\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rv\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 De septem gaudiis Mariae\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 : >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Incipiunt septem aue Maria in quibus includuntur septem gaudia uirginis que modo habet in celo< {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[7].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Suscipe benignissima uirgo Maria gaudia}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 illa \u8230 \'85 et\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 benedictus fructus uentris tui. Amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . Es folgen drei weitere Mariengebete. Das letzte schlie\u223 \'dft mit einer Bitte des Schreibers: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Scriptori vnum Aue Maria et vnum Salue regina\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\sl360\slmult1\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par}
Domina mea sancta Maria perpetua virgo
Ista oratio debet dici in sacramento altaris
Obsecro te domina sancta Maria mater
Salve regina mater misericordiae mater spes et mater veniae
Prima virtus hominis est audire missam
Ave domini Jesu Christe inclita proles
Salve mundi salutare salve salve Jesu care
Intacta mater quam deus prae omnibus dilexit
Sequentiae per annum et in festis sanctorum

HYPERLINK "hida://5650[4].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 >D<vbitatur vtrum primus homo deum viderit per essentiam}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Respondetur, quod primus homo in statu innocencie non viderit deum per essentiam immediate secundum communem statum illius vite clariorem, cum habebat cognicionem de deo per effectus quam de omnium lege habeatur in statu huius miserie seu nature lapse\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . Zitate aus: Hugo de Sancto Victore, De sacramentis, p. 6, c. 14, PL 176, 271C. \endash Boethius, De consolatione philosophiae, li. 3, prosa X, PL 63, 764D. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (97r-97\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) De resurrectione, quaestiones 1-2: {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[13].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 >U<trum prius tempore ante omnes alios resurrexerit}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Pro quo notandum, quod duplex est resurrectio quedam perfecta quasi quis eripitur a morte similiter, scilicet actu et potencialiter et ad vitam pervenit inmortalem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (97\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) De purgatorio et morte, quaestiones 1-2: {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[9].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 >N<ota secundum augustinum et alios doctores quod purgatorium est situm in medio terre}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Videtur non, quod in medio terre sunt quatuor receptabilia\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (!).\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Primum est inferior mansio et vocatur infernus infimus et in ista sunt eternaliter dampnati et habent duplicem penam, scilicet penam dampni, hoc est carenciam dei et eius wultus divini et habent penam sensus, que infligatur eis per demones\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . Zitat aus: Dionysius Areopagita, De ecclesiastica hierarchia, c. 2, contemplatio \u167 \'a7 7, Ed.: PG 3, 403-404, dt. \u220 \'dcbers.: Pseudo-Dionysius Areopagita\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ,\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u220 \'dcber die himmlische Hierarchie. \u220 \'dcber die kirchliche Hierarchie. Eingel., \u252 \'fcbers. und mit Anm. versehen von G\u252 \'fcnter \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Heil\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . Stuttgart 1986 (Bibliothek der griechischen Literatur 22), S. 100. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (97\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -98\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) De cogitatione turpium et ignorantia, quaestiones 1-2: {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[6].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 >D<vbium an omnis cogitatio turpium sit peccatum}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Sciendum quod cogitatio turpium duplex considerari potest. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Zitat aus: Alexander Halensis\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 OFM\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Summa theologica, li. 3, p. 2, inquisitio 3, tract. 2, sect. 2, q. 1, tit. 1, art. 2, Ed.: Opera omnia 4, 2, Ad claras aquas 1948, S. 628. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (98\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -98\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) De intentione orantis: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >D<vbium an ad hoc, quod fructuosa sit oracio requiratur orantis intencio. Notandum, quod triplex est effectus seu fructus oracionis. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Vgl. Thomas de Aquino, Summa Theologiae, IIa-IIe, q. 83, art. 13. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (98\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) De mendacio: {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[5].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 >D<vbium an omne mendacium sit peccatum mortale}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Notatur secundum augustinum in libro contra mendacium dicens: Mendacium est, falsa vocis significatio, cum intentione fallendi.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Vgl. Petrus Lombardus, Commentaria in psalmos, Ps. 5,6: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Verba mea\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , PL 191, 97-98. \endash Ders., Sententiae, li. 3, dist. 38, c. 3, PL 192, 834. \endash Augustinus, Liber contra mendacium, c. 12, PL 40, 536. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (98\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -99\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) De oratione, quaestiones 1-3: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >D<vbium an peccator orando inpetret quandoquoque aliquid a deo. Primo supposito, quod omnis oracio procedit ex desiderio ad illam rem, pro qua oratur. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Zitate aus: Liber Clementinarum, l. 3, tit. 16 (De reliquiis et veneratione sanctorum). \endash Thomas de Aquino, Summa Theologiae, IIa-IIe, q. 83, art. 16. \endash Augustinus, In Joannis evangelium tractatus, tract. 44. \endash Ders., De civitate Dei, li. 10, c. 1, PL 41, 278. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (99\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -99\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) De visione Dei, quaestiones 1-3: {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[8].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 >D<vbium vtrum idem sit premium omnium sanctorum}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Responditur quod licet idem sit et erit omnium sanctorum premium obiectale non tamen formale, quod consistit in obiecti beatifici, scilicet dei visione et fruicione\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . Zitate aus: Augustinus, De civitate Dei, li. 22, c. 33, PL 41, 802. \endash Thomas de Aquino, Super sententiis, li. 4, dist. 43, art. 2. \endash 100\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par}

De deo quesitum est et quantum ad naturam diuinam et quantum ad humanam assumptam. Quantum ad diuinam naturam quesitum est utrum beatus Benedictus in uisione qua uidit totum mundum diuinam essentiam uiderit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8230 \'85 Etc. Endet mit Quodlibet XII (131\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -138\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ): \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 >Quodlibet duodecimum. 1\plain \f1\i\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 o\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 < Quesitum est de rebus que sunt supra hominem et de rebus humanis. Circa primum quesitum est de deo quantum ad suum esse \u8230 \'85>XXXVIII< Secundo de pena eterna. Utrum anima separata a corpore naturaliter ab igne corporeo paciatur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 [Respondendum] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 sicut supra in vno quodlibeto, videlicet III q. XXIII. Et tamen de hiis omnibus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . \endash (138\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -142\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Sequitur registrum ad predictas questiones secundum ordinem alphabeti< Absoluere utrum possit in foro penitencii non habens curam animarum \u8230 \'85 Ydee utrum prius recipiant indiuiduum quam speciem, 6 q. 2. \endash Et sic est finis huius libelli. Laus deo omnipotenti\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . \endash 142\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -142a leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Druck: S. Thomae de Aquino opera omnia (s. o.). \endash Vgl. P. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Glorieux,\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 La litt\u233 \'e9rature quodlib\u233 \'e9tique (s. o.), S. 276-290, darin bedeutsam die dort dargebotene Entstehungsgeschichte der Sammlung.}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 2. 143\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -295\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Albertinus Veronensis: Postilla super Danielem \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Collectio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 [Seitentitel]. \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Postilla super Danielem Albertini. Collatio super librum< Suscitauit deus spiritum sanctum pueri iunioris cui nomen Daniel. Liber Danielis prophete singularis precellentia ostenditur uerbo scripto Danielis XIII\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 (45). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Quia uero hic propheta inter ceteros fuit ad uisiones altissimas \u8230 \'85 inuocamus eius gratiam qui aperit et nemo claudit. Qui sit benedictus in secula seculorum. Amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . \endash (145\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) [De prologo Hieronymi:] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 >Prologus Jeronimi super Danielem< Danielem iuxta etc. Libro Danielis premittit Jeronimus hunc prologum quem dirigit Paulo et Eustachio a quibus rogatur de Chaldea lingua in Latinam transtulit librum istum \u8230 \'85 blandientes aut odio oblatrantes.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 (147\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Incipit capitulum primum Danielis< Anno tertio regis Joachim etc. Liber iste diuiditur primo in partem eius secundum Hebreos autenticam \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Etc. Es folgen weitere 14 Kapitel. (290\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 >Capitulum XV< Erat draco magnus. Pars tertia et vltima in qua ponitur hystoria destructionis draconis \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 (Dn 14,22). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Et in hac primo ostenditur huius draconis erronea estimatio ... Et ipsi in corpore et anima de omnibus miseriis liberati cum Christo in celis eternaliter gloriantur. Ad quam gloriam nos perducat Christus Jhesus liberator et remunerator suorum fidelium qui sit benedictus in secula seculorum. Amen. \endash >Gratiarum actio< Igitur in fine huius operis offero tibi virgo beatissima quod gratiam tuam donasti in expositione huius libri. Et tu suscipias leto vultu si quid in hoc opusculo dignum est tibi offerri. Suscipias inquam per merita beati patris nostri Francisci \u8230 \'85Hoc enim est primum opusculum quod super textu sacro mihi pauperculo scribere inspirasti \u8230 \'85 Quiquid autem in premissis dictum est in expositione huius prophete tamquam fidelis christanus et deuotus filius humiliter subicio correctioni sanctissimi patris summi pontificis et ecclesie Romane. Deo gratias 1467\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . \endash 295\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -296\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Stegm\u252 \'fcller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 , RB 971. \endash Zum Verfasser vgl. Hanc doctrinam, quia plebis iudeorum habere noluit, ideo merito hostibus subiacuit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , RB, Nr. 2544,2\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 [10]\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Andr\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u233 \'e9\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 e\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , S. 172, Z. 12f. und kritischer Apparat zu Z. 12 und 13, ebd. Moraliter\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Anima \u8250 \'9bsola quasi uidua\u8249 \'8b bonis exuta uirtutum, que se subiecit dominio chaldeorum et \u8250 \'9bpubertatis sue\u8249 \'8b \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. Ioel 1,8)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 contempsit sponsum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ... \endash ... \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 intra mutato nomine in tenebras cecitatis. Unde iheremias exclamauit dicens\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , RB, Nr. 2544,2\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 [11]\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Andr\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u233 \'e9\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 e\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , S. 176, Z. 43-49. \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8250 \'9bIratus et contra nos\u8249 \'8b. Prima repulsio est, qua temptatori tradimur, secunda cum temptanti succumbimus, ad temptandum sine ira dei repellimur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ... \endash ... \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ite maledicti in ignem eternum, cum iam nec penitentie nec locus uenie erit. Sufficiant hec ad expositionem lamentationum iheremie, que de patrum fontibus hausi ego gillibertus altisiodorensis ecclesie diaconus.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , RB, Nr. 2544,2. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (2\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -54\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Glossa interlinearis: (ad Lam 1,1) {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[2].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 \u8250 \'9bQuomodo\u8249 \'8b affectuose, admiratiue}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . \u8250 \'9bSedet\u8249 \'8b habitu plorantis; humiliata. \u8250 \'9bSola\u8249 \'8b auxilio dei et angelorum; olim populosa. \u8250 \'9bCiuitas\u8249 \'8b Ierusalem, ecclesia uel anima. \u8250 \'9bPopulo\u8249 \'8b ex gentibus et tribubus et linguis congregata. \u8250 \'9bSola ... populo\u8249 \'8b ab opposito\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ... \endash ... \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8250 \'9bPrinceps prouinciarum\u8249 \'8b ecclesiarum, sensuum. \u8250 \'9bFacta est sub tributo\u8249 \'8b demonum, uiciorum, chaldeorum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Andr\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u233 \'e9\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 e\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , S. 172, Z. 5-10. \endash (ad Lam 5,22) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8250 \'9bProhiciens\u8249 \'8b a te qui ubique es. \u8250 \'9bExpulisti nos\u8249 \'8b quasi pollutos. \u8250 \'9bIratus es contra nos\u8249 \'8b. Peccatis nostris ut pater ne irascaris ut iudex. \u8250 \'9bContra nos\u8249 \'8b contrarios tibi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (2\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -54\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Bibeltext: Lam 1,1-5,22. \endash 54\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Rezension \plain \f2\i\lang1032\fs20 \u936 \'d8\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 (nach 1160 entstandene Handschriften). Inportuna narratio musica intelligitur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. Sir 22,6). Augustinus, De peccatorum meritis et remissione, PL 44, 172. \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Augustinus. Queritur quo tempore quibusue regibus historia iudith fuerit, ob hoc precipue, quia reges, qui ibi erant notati, arphaxat scilicet nabuchodonosor apud historias assiriorum et medorum in ordine regum non reperiuntur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ... \endash ... \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 cum regnum assiriorum atque persarum unum esset, aliquem regem nomine arphaxat in media repugnantem uicerit atque suo imperio subiugauerit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , RB, Nr. 11798\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 1\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . Hrabanus Maurus, Expositio in librum Judith. PL 109, 541D-543D. \endash (ad Idt 16,29) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8250 \'9bLuxitque\u8249 \'8b etc. Electi dei per omne tempus, quod septem diebus euoluitur ... \endash ... sed future uite recordatione iuxta illud: \u8250 \'9bFleuimus, dum recordaremur syon\u8249 \'8b\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Ps 136,1). \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , RB, Nr. 11798. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (75\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -97\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Glossa interlinearis: (ad Idt 1,1) {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[2].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Superbi. Quo tempore historia iudith fuerit, prenotatur}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Superbi enim super omnes esse cupiunt. Ampliauit; deiocus enim condidit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , RB, Nr. 11798\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 4\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash (ad Idt 16,31) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Transitoribus quorum unus dicebat. Peregrinus sum sicut omnes patres mei. Confessoribus christi. Quo per baptismum inimici potestatem euaserunt. Dum durat presens seculum.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , RB, Nr. 11798. \uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 97\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -113\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezper[0].4100/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Gilbertus Universalis (?)}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 : {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Liber Esther cum Glossa ordinaria}} \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (97\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Praefatio: {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[2].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 >L<ibrum hester uariis translationibus constat esse uiciatum}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 , quem ego de archiuis hebreorum eleuans, uerbum e uerbo expressius transtuli\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ... \endash ... \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 nos enim iuxta morem hebreorum ordinem prosequi etiam in septuaginta editione maluimus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . Hieronymus, Praefatio in librum Esther, PL 28, 1433A-1436A und 1435, Fu\u223 \'dfnote a. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (97\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -113\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Glossa marginalis: (ad Est 1,1) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Rabanus. {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[1].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Liber hester, quem hebrei inter agiographa numerant}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 , christi et ecclesie continet sacramenta: hester enim in typo ecclesie populum liberat de periculo et interfecto aman, qui interpretatur iniquitas, partes conuiuii et diem celebrem mittit in posteros\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , RB, Nr. 11799\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 1\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . Hrabanus Maurus, Expositio in librum Ester, PL 109, 635C. \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Historiam hester tempore assueri fuisse non dubitamus, sed quis fuerit, assueri ignoramus. Iosephus tamen memorat fuisse cyrum xersis filium\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ... \endash ... \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 eusebius in cronicis suis arbitrabatur hunc artaxerxem, qui cognominatus est mennon darii et paristidis \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (!) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 filium. Hic ab hebreis assuerus a septuaginta interpretibus arthaxersis uocatur, qui regnauit post darium patruum annis quadraginta\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , RB, Nr. 11799\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 1\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . Vgl. Hrabanus Maurus, Expositio in librum Ester, PL 109, 636C-637A. \endash (ad Est 10,1) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Christus, qui excisus de monte sine manibus, creuit in montem magnum et impleuit totum mundum. Historialiter enim non omnem terram tributariam fecit, quia nec habuit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , RB, Nr. 11799. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (98\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -113\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Glossa interlinearis: (ad Est 1,3){\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[0].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 \u8250 \'9bHomo quidam fecit cenam magnam et uocauit multos\u8249 \'8b (Lc 14,16). Unde \u8250 \'9bsimile est regnum celorum}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 homini regi qui fecit nuptias filio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u8249 \'8b (Mt 22,2). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Fecit assuerus, qui christum nomine ostendit et dignitate interpretauit atrium meum uel hostium, christus autem dicit: \u8250 \'9bEgo sum hostium ouium\u8249 \'8b\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Io 10,7). \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , RB, Nr. 11799\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 3\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . Vgl. Hrabanus Maurus, Expositio in librum Esther, PL 109, 639C. \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8250 \'9bQuos neque mors neque uita separabit a caritate christi\u8249 \'8b\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Rm 8,35). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Preclaris ecclesiarum. In beneplacito suo.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \endash (ad Est 3,10) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Verus iudeus non in manifesto, in carne, sed in abscondito, in spiritu\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. Rm 2,28). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Gratus et acceptus. Christianorum. Eterna. Quem regit. In hoc seculo et in futuro. \u8250 \'9bQuam speciosi pedes euangelizantium pacem euangelizantium bona\u8249 \'8b\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Rm 10,15). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Et alibi: \u8250 \'9bRogate que ad pacem sunt ierusalem\u8249 \'8b\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Ps 121,6). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Filiorum spiritualium.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , RB, Nr. 11799. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (97\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 -113\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) Bibeltext Est 1,1-10,3. Zusatz: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Que habentur in hebreo plena fide expressi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 H\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 <\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ec autem, que secuntur, scripta repperi in edicione uulgata, que grecorum lingua et litteris continentur et interim post finem libri hoc capitulum ferebatur: quod iuxta consuetudinem nostram obelo, id est uerum prenotauimus dixitque mardocheus etc.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Hieronymus, Liber Esther, PL 28, 1445A. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Druck: Editio princeps (s. Nr. 1), Bd. 2, [180]\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 -[187]\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs20 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 . \endash PL 113, 739C-748C. \endash Vgl. auch PL 109, 635C-670D. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par}

Act. IX\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 (15). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Homines in sacra scriptura inueniuntur vasis comparari propter quatuor \u8230 \'85\endash \u8230 \'85 Nam ipsa gratia Christi tripliciter potest considerari: vno modo secundum se et sic commendatur in epistola ad Romanos. Alio modo secundum quod est in sacra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 [mento] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 gratie\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . \endash \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Stegm\u252 \'fcller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 , RB 8051. \endash (2\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Capitulum primum ad Romanos< Paulus seruus Jhesu Christi c. 1. Diuiditur autem hec epistola in duo \u8230 \'85 in saluta-cionem et tractatum qui circa primum tria facit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8230 \'85 \endash (118\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ei qui potens est etc.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 (Rom 16,25) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 sit honor et gloria per Jhesum Christum cui est honor et gloria. Si autem ibi non sit ly cui erit constructio plana. Ex Lindow XXII mensis May anno domini M\plain \f1\i\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 o\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 CCCC LXVI etc. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Stegm\u252 \'fcller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 , RB 8051. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \par}
