Leuit. XXVI\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 (10). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Hec uerba competunt presenti epistole, in qua apostolus redarguit Galathas\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8230 \'85 (118\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Scribit ergo apostolus Galathis hanc epistolam in qua ostendit quid adueniente gratia noui testamenti debet proici uetus testamentum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8230 \'85 \endash (163\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 vb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 / 164\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 cum spiritu vestro quo scil. debitis legem obseruare et non carnaliter. Rom. VIII\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 (15). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Non enim accepistis spiritum seruitutis iterum in timore etc. Laudes dicimus Jhesu Christo Marie virginis filio. Amen\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . \endash 164\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -164\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Vgl. RB 8054. \endash Zu Druckausgaben beider Texte s. oben Traditio 13 (1957). \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \par}

Paulum postea secutus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8230 \'85 Etc. \endash RB 11829\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 1\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (2\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -136\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 rc\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) Textanfang fehlt. Setzt ein mit Lc 1,5: \plain \f2\lang1037\fs22\cf1 \u1472 ?\u1472 ?\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 [sacerdos qui]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 dam nomine Zacharias\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8230 \'85 Etc. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (2\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) Glossa marginalis, entnommen den Kommentaren von Ambrosius und Beda: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Zacharias memor domini\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8230 \'85 PL 114, 244 C. \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Abia pater dominus etc. aptum fuit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8230 \'85; \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Elisabeth dei mei saturitas significat Mariam que plena deo fuit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . \endash PL 114, 244 D. \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Prius mandatum, secunda est iustificatio \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \endash PL 92, 310 B. \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Factum est autem cum ex precepto Moysi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8230 \'85 PL 114, 245 A. \endash (2\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 rc\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Impleuit ordinem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8230 \'85 PL 114, 245 C. \endash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Cum Dauid cultum domus domini ampliaret \u8230 \'85 sicut per septem uetus declaratur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . \endash >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Ambrosius< Non enim omnis qui iustus est \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 PL 15, 1541 A. \endash >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 B\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 [eda\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ]< Diuinitus procuratum est \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 PL 92, 310 C. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (2\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) Glossa interlinearis: [qui]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 dam nomine Zacharias\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 (Lc 1,5). \plain \f2\lang1037\fs22\cf1 \u1472 ?\u1472 ?\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs22\cf1 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 sublimis et religione. Tales enim parentes habere prenuntius debuit, ut uite nature infusam fidem aduentus Christi predicaret.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Etc. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (136\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) Ende des Evangeliums, Lc 24,53: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Et erant semper in templo laudantes et benedicentes deum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (136\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ra\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) Glossa marginalis: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Lucas qui sacerdotium Christi ceteris amplius exponendo suscepit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8230 \'85 PL 92, 636 A. \endash (136\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 rc\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) Hier endet die Glosse zu Vers 50: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Premissis omnibus que per XL dies gesta sunt primo resurrectionis diei tacite coniungite \u8230 \'85 desiderio pariter et amore firmaret\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . \endash PL 92, 633 A \endash 634 A. \endash Anschlie\u223 \'dfend letzte Glosse: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Et in loco orationis \u8230 \'85 quando reuertatur a nuptiis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . \endash PL 92, 634 (auszugsweise). \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (136\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) Glossa interlinearis: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Regressi sunt in Ierusalem\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 (Lc 24,52). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Ubi promissionem patris iussi sunt expectare. In templo laudantes et benedicentes deum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 (Lc 24,53). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Quia dominum post triumphum resurrectionis in celos penetrare uident\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . \endash PL 92, 634 A. \endash Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 , RB 11829\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 16\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . \endash 236\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par}

Si consideres Jerusalem subuersam \u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 PG 12, 833 B. \endash \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Stegm\u252 \'fcller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 , RB 11786\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 2\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . \endash Die einzelnen Abschnitte der Glosse wechseln oft die Spalten. \endash (4\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 rc\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Alia litera< Heremum et Antelibanum quem a deo accepit Jhesus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8230 \'85 PG 12, 835 C. Ad Josue filium Nun. Jhesum dei filium\u8230 \'85\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Stegm\u252 \'fcller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 , RB 11786\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 4\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . Etc. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (55\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) Ende des Buches Josue: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Eleazar quoque filius Aaron mortuus est \u8230 \'85 data est ei in monte Effraim\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 (Ios 24,33) \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (55\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 rc\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) Glossa marginalis: [Augustinus:] \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Mirum est quod saltem in nouissimis uerbis quibus populum allocutus est non eos obiurgauit \u8230 \'85 ait: In prima mea defensione nemo mihi affuit, sed omnes me dereliquerunt quod non illis imputabitur\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 (2 Tim 4,14). \endash PL 34, 792. \endash \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Ste\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24\cf1 g\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24\cf1 m\u252 \'fcller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 , RB 11786\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 4\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 117\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 -132\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Liber Danielis secundum versionem Theodotionis \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Incipit prologus Danihelis prophetae< Danihelem prophetam iuxta septuaginta interpretes domini saluatoris ecclesie non legunt \u8230 \'85\endash \u8230 \'85 aut amore labuntur \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 (?)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 aut odio. \endash >Explicit prefatio Danihelis prophetae<\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Stegm\u252 \'fcller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ,RB 494. \endash >\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Incipit Danihel propheta< Anno tertio regni Joachimi regis Juda uenit Nabuchodonosor ex Babilonis\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8230 \'85(121\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) nach Vers 3,23 Rubrik: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 >Que sequuntur in hebreis uoluminibus non repperi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 < Fortsetzung des Textes: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Et ambulabant in medio flamme\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8230 \'85bis (122\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) Vers 3, 90: \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 confitemini ei quia in omnia secula misericordia eius\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . Danach Rubrik:>\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Huc usque non habetur in hebreo et que posuimus de Theodotionis editione translata sunt\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 <. Fortsetzung des Textes: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Tunc Nabuchodonosor rex obstupit \u8230 \'85\endash \u8230 \'85 et stabis in sorte tua in finem dierum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . (130\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 rb\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) Rubrik: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 >Hucusque Danihelem in hebraico uolumine legimus. Cetera que sequuntur usque finem libri de Theodotionis editione translata sunt\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 <. Fortsetzung mit Dn 13,1: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Erat vir habitans in Babylone et nomen eius Joachim\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \u8230 \'85\endash \u8230 \'85(132\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 va\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 et deuorati sunt in momento coram eo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 (Dn 14,41). Vers 42 fehlt hier. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 (118\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 oberer Rand bis 119\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24\cf1 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 ) Hier ist in Form einer Marginalglosse die Praefatio zu Jeremias des \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Hugo de s.\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Caro\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 nachgetragen: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Joachim filius Josie cuius terciodecimo anno prophetare orsus est\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\cf1 Hieremias sub quo etiam Olda mulier prophetauit \u8230 \'85\endash \u8230 \'85 ob quam regias dapes contempserunt\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\cf1 . Die einzelnen Abschnitte sind mit Buchstaben gekennzeichnet, die auf bestimmte Stellen im Text bezogen sind. \endash PL 25, 495 A- 497 C. \endash RB 490. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 179\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 r\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6922/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Variae notae de voluntate antecedente et consequente Dei}} \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 Textgrundlage der Exzerpte: \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 Thomas de Aquino, Quaestiones disputatae de veritate, q. 23 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De voluntate Dei\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , art. 2 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Utrum voluntas divina possit distingui per antecedens et consequens\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , art. 3 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Utrum voluntas Dei convenienter dividatur per voluntatem beneplaciti et voluntatem signi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , art. 4 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Utrum Deus de necessitate velit quicquid vult\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , art. 7 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Utrum teneamur voluntatem nostram conformare voluntati divinae.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \endash Ders., Summa theologiae, prima pars, q. 19 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De voluntate Dei\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , art. 11 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Utrum sit distinguenda in Deo voluntas signi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , art. 12 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Utrum convenienter circa divinam voluntatem ponantur quinque signa. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[0].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Propositio. Multa wult Deus voluntate beneplaciti antecedente ac voluntate signi}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 , que non wult voluntate beneplaciti consequente. Item illud, quod Deus wult voluntate antecedente hoc fieri. Sciendum est positiue, wult verbi gratia \u8250 \'9bDeus wult omnem hominem saluum fieri\u8249 \'8b\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (ITm 2,4) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 voluntate auctoritate. Et hoc vere wult. Et contra hoc nemo potest facere, quoniam ita velit\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. De verit., q. 23, art. 3) ... \endash ... \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 voluntas diuina beneplaciti diuiditur in antecedentem: Damascenus\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 <in> \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 libro 2\u176 \'b0 dicit: Oportet scire, quod Deus voluntate antecendente wult omnes saluos fieri, non autem consequente\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. De verit., q. 23, art. 2) ... \endash ... <voluntas diuina beneplaciti diuiditur in> \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 consequentem: Propositio. Quicquid Deus wult voluntate consequente fieri, necesse est fieri. Et quicquid wult, non fieri est impossibile\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. De verit., q. 23, art. 4) ... \endash ... \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 voluntas signi diuiditur: prohibicionem, preceptum, consilium, operacionem, permissionem. Augustinus in encheridion: Nichil fit, nisi omnipotens fieri velit, uel sinendo ut fiat, uel ipse faciendo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Enchiridion de fide, spe et caritate, c. 95, ed. PL 40, 276, CC 46, S. 96, Z. 28f). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Item inter voluntatem diuinam et voluntatem diuinam signi est realis dictinctio. Similiter inter voluntatem antecedentem, consequentem et signi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. Summa theol. I\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 a\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , q. 19, art. 12) ... \endash ... \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 conclusio: In natura diuina proposita solum est vnica et simplicissima voluntas, que dicitur voluntas beneplaciti ..\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \endash ... \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 conclusio: Nullus homo voluntati diuine permissionum culpabilium conformare debet, sed quibus debet eidem se difformare\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. De verit., q. 23, art. 7). \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Vgl. Sancti Thomae Aquinatis Opera omnia (Leonina) 4, Rom 1888, S. 249 f.; 22, Rom 1973, S. 655-665, S. 668-673. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 179\plain \f1\super\lang1033\fs24 v\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezper[0].4100/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Thomas de Aquino}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 : {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Utrum Isidorus convenienter ieiunium definiat}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 (Super sententiis, li. 4, dist. 15, q. 3, art. 1, qc. 1) \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ex d\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 <ivo> \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 T\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 <homa>. {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[0].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat18 Ysidorus libro 6\u176 \'b0 ethymologiarum dicit: Jeiunium est parsymonia victus abstinentiaque ciborum}}\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (PL 82, 258, Nr. 65). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cum autem jeiunuium rationabiliter institutum sit ad satisfaciendum pro peccatis et in tali satisfactione non opportet, quod homo solum ab illis abstineat ... \endash ... jeiunium scilicet abstinentiam ab illis, que virtutem corrumpunt, in hoc quod dicit \u8250 \'9bparsymonia victus\u8249 \'8b. Et item abstinentia ab illis, quibus salua virtute liceret uti, in hoc quod dicit \u8250 \'9babstinentiaque ciborum\u8249 \'8b. Quia hoc habetur, quod non est idem \u8250 \'9bparsymonia victus\u8249 \'8b et \u8250 \'9babstinentia ciborum\u8249 \'8b, parsymonia nempe gulam excludit, abstinencia multiplicat commestionem, etiam salua virtute alias liceret uti\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Druck: \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20\cf1 Sancti Thomae Aquinatis ex ordine praedicatorum opera omnia. Bd. 10: Commentaria in quartum librum Sententiarum Petri Lombardi. Paris 1660, S. 265 (Text mit Abweichungen). \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par}
Isidorus in libro 6° ethymologiarum dicit: Ieiunium est parsimonia victus abstinentiaque ciborum
